mapper.select: SELECT f.following_id AS user_id, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_follows back WHERE back.follower_id = f.following_id AND back.following_id = #{viewerId}) AS mutual FROM user_follows f JOIN users u ON u.id = f.following_id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN user_author_affinity a ON a.viewer_id = #{viewerId} AND a.author_id = f.following_id WHERE f.follower_id = #{viewerId} ORDER BY a.score DESC NULLS LAST, f.created_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t.id AS trip_id, t.name, t.start_date, t.end_date FROM trips t WHERE t.is_deleted = FALSE AND t.start_date IS NOT NULL AND t.end_date IS NOT NULL AND t.end_date >= #{today} AND t.start_date <= #{until} AND (t.owner_id = #{viewerId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM trip_members m WHERE m.trip_id = t.id AND m.user_id = #{viewerId} AND m.status = 'ACCEPTED')) ORDER BY t.start_date, t.id LIMIT 5

SELECT d.trip_id, d.start_date, d.end_date, COALESCE(d.is_primary, FALSE) AS is_primary, goroute_province_at(d.lat, d.lng) AS province_code FROM trip_destinations d WHERE d.trip_id IN #{id} AND d.lat IS NOT NULL AND d.lng IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT t.id, t.start_date, t.end_date, TRUE, goroute_province_at(t.destination_lat, t.destination_lng) FROM trips t WHERE t.id IN #{id} AND t.destination_lat IS NOT NULL AND t.destination_lng IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM trip_destinations d WHERE d.trip_id = t.id AND d.lat IS NOT NULL AND d.lng IS NOT NULL)
SELECT DISTINCT a.place_ref_id FROM activities a WHERE a.trip_id IN #{id} AND a.place_ref_id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(a.status, '') <> 'REJECTED' LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT w.province_code FROM passport_province_wishes w WHERE w.user_id = #{viewerId} AND w.province_code IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT recent.code FROM ( SELECT COALESCE((SELECT wd.province_code FROM wards wd WHERE wd.code = c.ward_code), c.province_code) AS code FROM user_checkins c WHERE c.user_id = #{viewerId} AND c.is_removed = FALSE ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT #{recentCheckins} ) recent WHERE recent.code IS NOT NULL
SELECT name FROM provinces WHERE code = #{code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_author_affinity (viewer_id, author_id, score, updated_at) SELECT viewer_id, author_id, score, NOW() FROM ( SELECT viewer_id, author_id, score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY viewer_id ORDER BY score DESC) AS rank_in_viewer FROM ( SELECT x.viewer_id, fi.author_id, SUM(x.weight * POWER(0.5, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - x.at)) / 86400.0 / #{halfLifeDays}::float8)) AS score FROM ( SELECT l.user_id AS viewer_id, 'CHECKIN'::varchar AS item_type, l.checkin_id AS item_id, #{likeWeight}::float8 AS weight, l.created_at AS at FROM user_checkin_likes l WHERE l.created_at > #{since} UNION ALL SELECT v.user_id, 'REVIEW'::varchar, v.review_id, #{likeWeight}::float8, v.created_at FROM review_helpful_votes v WHERE v.is_helpful AND v.created_at > #{since} UNION ALL SELECT v.user_id, 'TRIP'::varchar, v.trip_id, #{likeWeight}::float8, v.created_at FROM trip_helpful_votes v WHERE v.is_helpful AND v.created_at > #{since} UNION ALL SELECT c.user_id, c.content_type::varchar, c.content_id, #{commentWeight}::float8, c.created_at FROM content_comments c WHERE c.is_deleted = FALSE AND c.created_at > #{since} UNION ALL SELECT s.user_id, s.post_type::varchar, s.post_id, #{saveWeight}::float8, s.created_at FROM saved_posts s WHERE s.created_at > #{since} UNION ALL SELECT i.user_id, i.item_type::varchar, i.item_id, #{openWeight}::float8, i.last_seen_at FROM feed_impressions i WHERE i.opened AND i.last_seen_at > #{since} UNION ALL SELECT i.user_id, i.item_type::varchar, i.item_id, #{dwellWeight}::float8, i.last_seen_at FROM feed_impressions i WHERE i.max_dwell_ms >= #{dwellMs} AND i.last_seen_at > #{since} ) x JOIN feed_items fi ON fi.item_type = x.item_type AND fi.item_id = x.item_id JOIN users viewer ON viewer.id = x.viewer_id WHERE fi.author_id <> x.viewer_id GROUP BY x.viewer_id, fi.author_id ) pairs WHERE score >= #{minScore}::float8 ) ranked WHERE rank_in_viewer <= #{perViewer}
